outline:
This course covers the following topics:
1. Number systems and conversion
2. Boolean algebra
3. Simplification of Boolean algebra
4. Gate Circuits
5. Combinational Circuit Design
6. Flip-Flops, Registers, and Counters
7. Introduction to VHDL
8. Sequential Circuits
9. State Graphs and Tables
schedule:
Week 1. Introduction
Week 2. Boolean Algebra & Logical Gates (I)
Week 3. Boolean Algebra & Logical Gates (II)
Week 4. Minterm and Maxterm Expansions
Week 5. Karnaugh Maps
Week 6. Quine-McClusky Method
Week 7. Multi-Level Gate Circuits
Week 8. Combinational Circuit Design and Simulation Using Gates (I)
Week 9. Midterm Exam
Week 10. Combinational Circuit Design and Simulation Using Gates (II)
Week 11. Multiplexers, Decoders, and Programmable Logic Devices
Week 12. Introduction to VHDL
Week 13. Latches and Flip-Flops
Week 14. Registers and Counters
Week 15. Analysis of Clocked Sequential Circuits
Week 16. Derivation of State Graphs and Tables
Week 17. Sequential Circuit Design
Week 18. Final Exam
